Who We Are
Throwback is the Party You’ve Been Missing

Throwback is an experiential wellness brand focused on one thing: FUN. We host private events for all kinds of celebrations — kids' birthday parties, 30th, 40th, and 50th milestone celebrations, bachelorette and bachelor parties, wedding parties, and plenty of friendly get-togethers.

We evolved from a 'throwback'-themed NYC fitness studio where we had a unique approach to working out. Now we bring that same energy to private events across the country, blending classic field day staples with our own original creations.

Every event is fully customizable — we'll work with you to build an itinerary that fits your group's vibe and occasion. Whether your crew wants to flex their competitive muscles or keep it chill with brain teasers and trivia, we've got you covered.

The result? Your group laughing, reconnecting, and leaving with actual memories — the kind a regular party never quite delivers. Recess for everyone.

New York’s Favorite Party Experience — Now Hosting Events Across the Country

With over 300 five-star reviews and clients including ClassPass, Morgan Stanley, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, and Spotify — we've helped hundreds of teams play their way to better culture.

The Experience
How Your Event Comes Together
1

We Plan Together

Our team works with you ahead of the event to build a custom game itinerary — tailored to your group size, energy level, venue, and any special themes or goals you have in mind.

2

Meet at the Field

Gather at a local park or venue of your choice. Groups get split into teams and receive their team-colored bandanas — which everyone gets to keep as a souvenir.

3

Play 5–8 Games

Over two hours, your team competes in a curated lineup of games while our experienced coaches officiate, keep score, and keep the energy high throughout.

4

Champions Are Crowned

Coaches announce the winning team — and everyone goes home with new inside jokes, stronger bonds, and a story they’ll be telling for years.
